title: The Layers header carries Make Component and a panel menu, as the mocks draw it
goal: The Layers panel header shows only its title. Both component mocks draw a count of layers, a Make Component button and a panel menu there (Group Selection, Make Component, Hide this panel), which is the one-click way to turn a picked group into a component that the components epic asks for. Today it is only in the right-click menu, the Layer menu and Option Command K.
notes: Manager review 2026-10-08 of ui-components. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/component-configure-wt.html lines ~272-276 (dgrp-h: ttl Layers, cnt, btnMakeComp ic-component, ic-more data-menu layerMenu) and components.html lines ~425-430 (layerMenu items). App: Sources/Photonz/InspectorPanel.swift dock headers (around 1173-1291) have no Layers case; Make Component lives in LayerCommandMenu.swift ~194 and the Layer menu with Option Command K. The done dock-headers work only covered Properties and the Library. Placement: a panel header verb that the mock places, so no card.
acceptance: The Layers header shows the layer count, a Make Component icon button (tooltip Make Component with its shortcut) and a panel menu button, as component-configure-wt.html and components.html draw them, using the same header row the Properties and Library headers use
Make Component is dimmed when the pick cannot become a component and does exactly what Option Command K does when it can
The panel menu holds Group Selection, Make Component and Hide this panel, each doing what its menu bar twin does
Shown in Next at defaults wherever the Layers panel shows; Current is unchanged unless the header file is shared, in which case it follows the porting rule
A walk at Next defaults picks a group, presses the header button, and checks the group wears the component ring and badge in Layers and on the canvas; undo takes it back
Side by side with both mocks in the audit, light and dark. Try: draw two shapes, group them with Command G, press the component button in the Layers header. Audit written under queue/audits/
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task log if it does not

log.note: Placement: UX-PATTERNS.md line ~362 says a dock group header is chevron + title + optional count + optional buttons, so a header button is within the contract. The open card on the-panel-shows-what-the-picked-thing-is-and-its (how many buttons the panel keeps) is about buttons inside sections, not group headers; if it is answered with no buttons at all, re-read it before building.

Adversarial review before build: a Photoshop user expects a Layers flyout menu (Photoshop has one), so the panel menu meets expectation; the header already hosts buttons (Motion play, Effects plus) so a button inside the collapse/reorder gesture is proven. No mock assumption the app cannot deliver.

left rough (below the bar): a walk's key step cannot press menu-bar chords on a background probe (harness says so), so the walk groups with action group; and panelMenu logs show a leading '—' for every pull-down (the hidden title slot), same on the Properties menu, harmless.

Audit rough lines all describe matches; nothing to file. Walks run: layers-header-make-component, dock-headers, component-walk, component-whole-path, shared-component, tutorial-make-a-component all ok.

Layers header shows count, Make Component button (dimmed when it cannot act, same as Option Command K) and a panel menu (Group Selection, Make Component, Hide This Panel) in Next at defaults. Core words in PhotonzCore/LayersPanelHeader (tested), view in LayersPanelHeaderControls.swift. Verified: Scripts/test.sh 11862 passed, layers-header-make-component-walk green with real captures light and dark, audit queue/audits/2026-10-08-layers-header.json. Commit 9916955e.
